**PhD Student** · Forest Monitoring & Geospatial Analysis

[Department of Natural Resource Ecology& Management](https://go.okstate.edu/undergraduate-academics/majors/natural-resource-ecology-and-management) · [Oklahoma State University](https://go.okstate.edu/)

---

## 👋 Hello, this is Dingjin.

I am a PhD student studying **Above ground biomass estimation, cooling effect of Urban green space, and forest disturbance** using remote sensing across different different platforms with filed investigation data. I work with satellite imagery, Airborne LiDAR data, and statistical modeling to understand how forests respond to climate variability and human disturbance.

My research interests sit at the intersection of forest ecology, remote sensing, and environmental data science.
